run.name: burst3
run.result: completed; configuration restored; no instrumentation load errors

tracking.assessment: 17-frame capacity exceeded the ceil(12*1.2)=15 engineering bound for this run; this single run does not prove a sustained margin.

behavioral.assessment: 17-frame capacity exceeded the ceil(7*1.2)=9 engineering bound for this run; this single run does not prove a sustained margin.

acquisition_recording_queue.pending_record_headroom: The 10000-record limit was not approached; max observed was 13 for tracking and 8 for behavioral.

visual_capture_slots.assessment: The 21-slot cap was saturated, so measured occupancy is censored by the cap. A 20% scaling gives 26 only as a lower-bound sizing probe, not an adequate-capacity recommendation. High capacity-drop share indicates that capture throughput must be investigated before treating added slots as a fix.

behavioral.assessment: Last valid retrieve was about 64.9 ms after the trial cutoff (terminal start was about 46.7 ms after cutoff), within the configured 125 ms post-cutoff margin. stop_capture duration is reported separately and is not treated as delivery demand.

tracking.assessment: No valid retrieval was observed after terminal start in this run.

eye_tracking.assessment: No trial camera recording; eye camera settings are included above to prevent treating inactive configuration as an exercised stream.

tracking.assessment: Observed maximum success interval was below the 1.2 s engineering bound.

behavioral.assessment: Observed maximum success interval was below the 1.2 s engineering bound.

tracking.assessment: Observed maximum success interval was below the 1.2 s engineering bound.

behavioral.assessment: Observed maximum success interval was below the 1.2 s engineering bound; one file-sync call had a 25.5 ms duration.

visual_review_video.assessment: The maximum observed success interval exceeded the 1.2 s engineering bound. Keep this as a cadence outlier for further sampling; sync call durations were short and error-free.

visual_evidence_file.assessment: Observed cadence was below the 1.2 s engineering bound and pending-byte peak remained far below the configured limit.

tracking_camera_encoder.assessment: Average blocking write time was small relative to the frame period, but the observed maximum write and progress-observation gaps exceeded a 1.2x frame-period reference; treat maxima as transient tail evidence, not a throughput estimate.

behavioral_camera_encoder.assessment: Average blocking write time was small relative to the frame period, but tail write/observation gaps exceeded a 1.2x frame-period reference; no frame-loss guarantee follows from this single run.

visual_review_encoder.assessment: Input capture throughput remains the dominant concern alongside a saturated capture cap. No progress interval is available for this visual encoder in this probe.

engineering_bound_method.queue_occupancy: ceil(observed high-water * 1.2); compare with configured capacity in frame slots as the requested heuristic, while noting occupancy metric is waiting pixels and is not a strict same-unit capacity measure.
engineering_bound_method.visual_capture: ceil(configured slots * 1.2) is a minimum next probe target only because observed high-water reached the cap; sustained drops require a throughput diagnosis and do not establish that 26 slots are adequate.
engineering_bound_method.sync_cadence: 1.2 * configured 1 s interval = 1.2 s maximum success-to-success reference.
engineering_bound_method.encoder_write_tail: 1.2 * configured frame period is a diagnostic comparison only; a maximum individual blocking interval is not a direct sustained throughput measurement.

limitations_and_caveats: The probe is in-process timing instrumentation using perf_counter_ns and aggregate-only counters. It writes no per-frame records; one summary is emitted at lifecycle boundaries. Instrumentation adds some CPU work, with no quantified overhead calibration.
Metrics are for one unpaired 60-second trial; maxima are outlier observations, not statistical guarantees.
The actual active camera settings are copied from SESSION_CONFIG.json. Eye tracking is configured but disabled and was not an active recorded stream.
Several later preview/control lifecycle events in occupancy JSONL files fall outside the trial monotonic interval and are excluded from trial metrics.
Visual capture occupancy is cap-censored at 21 with 2666 capacity drops. Increasing slots alone is not demonstrated to fix throughput.
Visual review encoder progress sampling returned zero observations; do not infer progress cadence from camera encoder telemetry.
Rig evidence does not replace E15 acceptance outside this tested configuration and duration.
